elements_selected.content: Add scene chain validation diagnostics to cmd_check in src/main.rs per REQ-015-006. Scan all files for prev/next frontmatter. Build forward and backward maps. Emit five diagnostic types: broken forward link as error, asymmetric chain as warning, cycle detection as error with path, fan-in / multiple predecessors as error, orphaned chain nodes as warning. Integrate with existing check output format. When --verbose, log chain summary per OBS-015-001: number of chains found and chain lengths. REQ-015-006, OBS-015-001.
Modified 6 files (+310, -10): .hence/context-manifest.json, src/main.rs, src/web/chain.rs, src/web/context.rs, src/web/mod.rs and 1 more
